_comment: Desired state of Pocket-ID OIDC clients + groups (ADR 0022). BIJECTIVE: anything not listed here is PRUNED by the reconciler. It manages policy only, never client secrets. To add an app: create its client here, run the reconciler, then bootstrap the new client_secret into that app's SOPS by hand.

clients._comment: MACHINE client for the agent broker's vault adapter (agent-broker plan P5). No callbackURLs: it never runs authorization_code — only client_credentials, whose token carries the client identity in sub=client-<uuid>. That UUID is what MCP_ALLOWED_CLIENT_IDS lists on the vault MCP, and what makes an aud-forged token from any OTHER client fail. Its client_secret lives ONLY in the vault-adapter's SOPS Secret and never enters a loge.
clients.name: agent_broker_vault

clients._comment: P11 (agora refactoring): OneCLI's own admin dashboard, gated via oauth2-proxy (same pattern as code-server) since OneCLI has no native OIDC. Client created directly against the API (POST /oidc/clients, then POST /oidc/clients/{id}/secret to reveal the secret) before this entry was added — the reconciler's own CREATE path only logs the id, never the secret, so a fresh client's secret must always be bootstrapped by hand regardless of which caller creates it (ADR 0022).
clients.name: onecli

clients._comment: Agent Vault's management UI (infrastructure/agent-vault) — the credential vault for agent runtimes, same posture as 'onecli'. Secret bootstrapped the same way.
clients.name: agent-vault

clients._comment: Agora's server (apps/agora, agora.bretagne.dev), gated via oauth2-proxy: it starts Kata VMs, so operators only. Secret bootstrapped the same way as 'onecli' (rotated 2026-10-03, when the server moved here from agora-lab).
clients.name: agora

clients._comment: Home Assistant (apps/home-assistant): the app is its own OIDC relying party (hass-oidc-auth), no oauth2-proxy in front — the Companion app cannot cross a cookie gate (ADR 0021, amendment 2026-09-05). PUBLIC client + PKCE (RFC 7636): there is NO client_secret, nothing to bootstrap into SOPS. The only value to copy after the first reconcile is the minted client_id -> apps/home-assistant/oidc-configmap.yaml. Group-restricted to admin; HA mirrors it (auth_oidc.roles.user/admin = admin).
clients.name: home-assistant

clients._comment: Prefect (apps/prefect, prefect.bretagne.dev), the orchestrator of Agora's workflows, gated via oauth2-proxy: its runs start Agora executions, so operators only. Secret bootstrapped the same way as 'onecli' (created 2026-10-07).
clients.name: prefect

clients._comment: The RSS stack (apps/rss, rss.bretagne.dev): Miniflux, gated via oauth2-proxy, which signs the user in from the e-mail it passes. Secret bootstrapped the same way as 'onecli' (created 2026-10-07).
clients.name: rss

clients._comment: Previews (ADR 0017 v4 §7): one client for every preview gate, each an oauth2-proxy in preview-system at pr-<n>-<app>.preview.bretagne.dev. The single-label wildcard matches exactly one DNS label under preview.bretagne.dev (Pocket-ID >= 2.4.0 closed the userinfo bypass, CVE-2026-28512). Created directly against the API on 2026-10-23 like 'onecli', but Pocket-ID v2 renamed the secret route: POST /oidc/clients/{id}/secrets (plural); v2 also auto-creates a first secret at client creation, which was deleted since its value was never kept. The secret lives only in preview-system/preview-gate.
clients.name: preview

clients._comment: MACHINE client for Agora's gateway on the previews (apps/agora-gateway, route `previews`; docs/specs/credentials.md on arnaultbretagne/agora, 'Previews'). The gateway presents its token to each preview's gateway gate (infrastructure/configs/previews), which names this id as its audience and client-<id> as its one identity (ConfigMap preview-gateway-identities). Used for client_credentials only. Restricted to no group (isGroupRestricted with none): no user may authorize it, so its device_code and refresh_token give nothing; no callbackURLs, so no authorization_code. Tokens live 15 minutes. Its secret is in agora-gateway/previews-client (previews-client.secrets.yaml), bootstrapped by hand: POST /api/oidc/clients/{id}/secrets.
clients.name: agora_gateway_previews
